old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-ta0c","title":"Persist Announce TOFU pins and replay floors across Node restarts","description":"P1 security: Node constructs AnnounceProcessor with fresh in-memory _pinned_keys and _seen tables and never includes them in LinkLayer or other crash-safe persistence. After restart a different first-seen key can replace the trust decision for an IID collision, and any old origin-signed Announce can be replayed through a currently authenticated relay because its fresh link counter does not protect the origin's 16-bit Announce sequence. This also leaves DaoOriginValidator without durable pre-pinned origin identities. Add fail-closed, rollback-resistant persistence for exact pubkey/IID pins and per-origin sequence floors, integrate it atomically with Node admission, and add reboot/corruption/relayed-stale tests.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T15:51:10.263603Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T15:51:10.263603Z"}
